texts: Whenever a cold wind blows off the sea at night, that wind extinguishes unprepared lanterns.
When a cold wind strikes the Cliff Path at night, unprepared lanterns go out.
Lanterns in shielded coves stay safe from cold winds.

fields.sentence: Whenever a cold wind blows off the sea at night, that wind extinguishes unprepared lanterns.
parse: (: wind_extinguish_rule (Implication (And (Member $x blow) (Patient $x $w) (Member $w wind) (Member $w cold) (Source $x sk_sea_1) (Time $x night) (Member $l lantern) (Member $l unprepared)) (And (Member (sk_extinguish $x $l) extinguish) (Agent (sk_extinguish $x $l) $w) (Patient (sk_extinguish $x $l) $l) (During (sk_extinguish $x $l) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: adjectivally-restricted bare-plural OBJECT under a generic ('extinguishes unprepared lanterns'): the instruction set legislates only the restricted-kind SUBJECT case ('stray dogs chase cyclists' -> restriction becomes a premise conjunct) and never the object case, so whether the restricted object becomes a premise range (universal over every unprepared lantern in the KB) or a per-occurrence Skolem group in the consequent is unspecified
review.notes: The wind is Patient of intransitive 'blow' (non-volitional natural force / gas) and Agent of transitive 'extinguish' (inanimacy never demotes a transitive subject), both exactly per the stated tests; 'cold wind' correctly stays unfused as incidental description, 'off the sea' takes Source, and 'at night' the bare day-part Time symbol. The premise-range treatment of 'unprepared lanterns' universally quantifies over all such lanterns, which is the natural bare-plural-object reading but is the undecided case flagged above.

fields.sentence: When a cold wind strikes the Cliff Path at night, unprepared lanterns go out.
parse: (: wind_lantern_rule (Implication (And (Member $e strike) (Agent $e $w) (Member $w wind) (Member $w cold) (Theme $e cliff_path) (Time $e night) (Member $x lantern) (Member $x unprepared)) (And (Member (sk_go_out $x $e) go_out) (Patient (sk_go_out $x $e) $x) (During (sk_go_out $x $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: The two universals (occurrence and lantern) are correctly premise conjuncts with a two-argument Skolem consequent event, "the Cliff Path" gets the name-plus-kind pair with no modifier genus, and "cold"/"unprepared" stay unfused incidental descriptions. `go_out` is kept whole with no genus and no synonym swap, and its subject takes the change-of-state Patient.

fields.sentence: Lanterns in shielded coves stay safe from cold winds.

q2_gaps: continuative copular "stay / remain + ADJ" on a KIND-level generic: the specified continuation shape is (Still <state-witness>) on a reified state, but a kind-level ConditionalProperty/Inheritance claim mints no state witness, so the continuation of "stay safe" has no carrier and is silently lost
review.notes: The locative restriction is kept in the condition slot rather than stripped, and safe_from_cold_wind follows the kind-level adjective+PP fusion pattern (genus + surface-preposition argument atom) with the bare copular Inheritance correctly not also asserted. Modifier genus atoms for shielded_cove and cold_wind pass the predication test, so their exposure is determined, not optional.
